family_treatment.name: CONCUSSIVE FRACTURE
family_treatment.evidence: 2026-10-19 director: 'Approved, proceed' to family and Blast Shield as first target
family_treatment.palette: Ember orange, incandescent gold, white-hot yellow, charcoal and burnt copper; deep crimson only as restrained accent; blue-white electrical trace only when supported (Charge 4 Explosion).
family_treatment.material: Concussive detonation: fractured stone, compressed chakra pressure and sharp blast-fronts, not lava, persistent fire or hydrothermal vapor.
family_treatment.rendering: Premium TNR crisp pixel clusters, coherent focal silhouette with dark negative space, one secondary effect, 125/64/32 legibility, no anatomy unless separately approved.

targets.name: Inferno Cataclysm
targets.action: Detonate a fissure in the ground into a devastating area eruption; historical capture describes fractured earth and explosive recoil.
targets.dominant_silhouette: One long, jagged split in the earth erupting into a brutal angled wall of incandescent pressure; no isolated fireball.
targets.camera: Elevated three-quarter view, looking down the torn ground plane; fissure clearly extends into depth.
targets.motion_axis: Lateral force tears ground open from the central crack while explosive pressure erupts upward toward the far edge.
targets.secondary_effect: One massive displaced stone slab to show violent ground breakup.

sibling_exclusions.silhouette: One compressed luminous projectile breaking apart into a controlled fan/constellation of smaller detonations; a distinct multi-burst breakup. ACTION: The main projectile travels toward the target then bursts radially into multiple distinct small charges.

A thick horseshoe-shaped compressed explosive-pressure wall with an unmistakably protected dark central void; the shield actively deflects an incoming strike. ACTION: Pressure drives outward from the protected center, while one incoming attack is redirected away from the wall.

A staggered, diagonal chain of small ground-contact detonations across a broad battlefield swath, NOT one large fireball or ring. ACTION: A controlled cascade propagates from the near lower-left ignition to the far upper-right detonation.

A single compressed diagonal shock-cone with a leading high-energy terminal collision blast and a sharply separate propulsion jet behind. ACTION: Fast thrust from upper-left to lower-right: narrow wake opens toward one hard, localized close-range impact.
